claims.proof: shared and copied installations have the same baseline tuples but distinct physical carrier identity; exhaustive enumeration
counterexamples_or_limits: a signature already containing complete carrier identity distinguishes them

claims.statement: Under the declared equations and fixed installation, an A-side calibration perturbation changes the B command iff the action-reference carrier is physically shared.
counterexamples_or_limits: intervention evidence does not create membership

claims.statement: Biological/prosthetic, deliberate/reflex and report labels do not determine ART or EAC in the declared domain.
counterexamples_or_limits: actual substrate or control differences may matter when physically specified

claims.statement: A deliberate-labelled and reflex-labelled twin can share the complete selected ART/EAC profile, so the profile alone cannot identify phenomenal trying.
counterexamples_or_limits: does not claim reflex and deliberate experiences are equal or unequal
